en: Black‑and‑white view into an enclosed courtyard between multi‑storey brick buildings. The architecture is late‑19th‑century European industrial or institutional style, with tall rectangular windows and simple brick facades. A central garden with trees and paths fills the yard, enclosed by wooden fences and a gate opening to a dirt road where a horse‑drawn water wagon stands. Several women in long light‑colored dresses stand near the entrance and along the right‑hand building, suggesting a school, convent, or hospital complex.
